name: BTC20 presale proxy claim exploit
summary: The presale priced BTC20 from a manipulable Uniswap spot quote, allowing a flash-loan-funded price manipulation to buy the remaining presale inventory below its market value.
notes: The sixth and final pre-incident Upgraded event selected the vulnerable PresaleV4 implementation.
The exploit trace ends with exactly 18.348059243787394323 ETH transferred from the attack contract to the attacker after the 300 WETH flash loan was repaid.
